scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-tight
scale.label: text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase

tracing_beam_card.description: Card with a glowing border effect on hover or looping.
tracing_beam_card.implementation: Use Framer Motion to animate a gradient border or a mask-image reveal. Card should have dark background, 1px border, and glow matching accent colors (Emerald or Electric Blue).

magnetic_pill.base: relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-medium transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
magnetic_pill.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-white/40

motion.philosophy: Cinematic, smooth, heavy motion but never jarring. Every interaction feels premium and intentional.

effects.staggered_reveal: Parent sets staggerChildren: 0.1, children animate y: 20 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1.
effects.scroll_parallax: Images and backgrounds translate slightly on scroll to create depth.
effects.hover_lift: Cards translateY(-8px) and increase shadow opacity on hover.
effects.magnetic_hover: Use framer-motion useMouse to slightly pull buttons towards cursor.

Home.Hero: 100vh height. Absolute positioning for cinematic abstract particles background. Center aligned text: 'AI-Driven Human Capital & Custom Software Solutions'. Large CTA magnetic buttons.
Home.Marquee: Opacity 50% grayscale logos running infinitely using react-fast-marquee.
Home.Divisions_Bento: Asymmetrical 12-col grid. Staffing & Recruitment card (Emerald theme) taking 7 cols, Innovation card (Blue theme) taking 5 cols. Video hover reveals.
Home.Industries: 3-column grid of tall cards. Dynamic hover states revealing full-background videos for Healthcare, Renewable Energy, and Construction.
Home.Why_Felipillon: Grid of feature cards with tracing beam glowing borders. Icons using Lucide React.
Home.Global_Footprint: Interactive globe (e.g., cobe or framer-motion SVG globe) with connection lines between Berlin, Pune, Makati City.
Home.Success_Metrics: Large typography counters triggering on intersection observer.

Divisions.Staffing_Recruitment: Focus on human elements, clean UI, healthcare/exec search visuals. Emerald accents.
Divisions.Innovation: Darker, highly technical, code snippets, server visuals, 3D grids. Electric Blue accents.

Navigation.Header: Sticky, glassmorphism nav bar. Transparent at top, blurs on scroll. Includes theme toggle and massive contact CTA.

Footer.Structure: Massive bottom padding. Grid layout for links. Enormous typography for brand name 'FELIPILLON' at the bottom.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract glowing dots and wave patterns, perfect for hero particles

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this entire JSON to implement the design system accurately.
Use Framer Motion heavily for page transitions, staggered text reveals, hover lifts, and magnetic buttons.
Implement the 'Crystal Glass' effect using the provided backdrop-blur utilities.
Ensure the theme toggler smoothly transitions colors. Default should be DARK.
For the animated globe, if cobe is complex to integrate quickly, use a Framer Motion rotating SVG or pure CSS interactive particle globe.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
